_comment: AlfieBot settings. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Delete a key to use its built-in default.

display._comment: The 5-inch Pi display is 1280x720 in landscape. Lower supersample or glow if the Pi runs slowly.

face._comment: transition_speed: how fast one expression morphs into the next (6 = about half a second; higher is faster). blink_interval: shortest and longest gap between blinks, in seconds (each gap is random between them).

conversation._comment: Seconds. listen_timeout: how long AlfieBot waits for an answer before going idle. sleep_after_idle: idle time before falling asleep. thinking_time: pause before replying. wake_delay: time for the eyes to open when woken from sleep.

speech._comment: tts_engine: auto (Piper if a Piper voice is installed, otherwise the Windows voice on Windows or espeak-ng on the Pi), piper, windows, espeak or none. piper_voice: the Piper voice in models/piper (get one with tools/download_voice.py). voice: part of a Windows voice name (e.g. Hazel or George) or an espeak voice (e.g. en-gb). rate: -10 (slow) to 10 (fast), Windows and espeak only. volume: 0-100. speed: overall speed for every voice and profile (1.0 normal, 0.8 slower, 1.2 faster). personality: bubbly (Bubbly Bot: cheerful, a little higher, sound effects) or classic (the v0.6 voice). voice_profile: auto (the personality picks a profile for each reply) or a profile name to always use it. pitch: semitones up (+) or down (-) for every profile (Piper and espeak-ng; Windows voices only if they support it). speaker_device: blank for the default speaker (Piper only). recognizer: vosk or none. mic_mode: open (listens whenever AlfieBot is listening) or push_to_talk (only while the button is held). mic_device: blank for the default microphone, or part of its name. min_confidence: spoken letters below this are checked with the child. wake_min_confidence: how sure the recogniser must be of "Hey AlfieBot" to wake (higher = fewer false wakes). allow_cloud_voices: parent setting, false by default. True lets the Voice panel compare with a Microsoft online voice (pip install edge-tts); only AlfieBot's own words are sent, never anything Alfie says. cloud_voice: e.g. en-GB-MaisieNeural (a child's voice) or en-GB-SoniaNeural.

voice_profiles._comment: Change how each profile sounds. rate: speed (1.0 normal, 0.8 slower). volume: 0-1. pitch: semitones (+2 = a little higher). sentence_pause, word_pause, letter_pause: seconds. expressiveness: Piper only, 1.0 normal. Leave a profile out to use the built-in settings, e.g. "teacher": {"letter_pause": 0.9}. Bubbly Bot's profiles are bubbly_conversation, bubbly_excited, clear_spelling_teacher and bubbly_sleepy.

spelling._comment: How spoken spellings are checked. confirm_spoken_answers: always (AlfieBot reads the letters back for a yes before marking) or when_unsure (only when a letter was unclear). phonetic_words: child (B for ball), nato (B for bravo) or off, used when AlfieBot asks about an unclear letter. finish_after_pause: seconds of quiet after some letters before AlfieBot checks them (0 = wait for 'finished'). recognition_mode: continuous (say the letters in a run) or letter_by_letter (one letter at a time; AlfieBot ticks after each).

learning._comment: Spelling practice and review. review_days: how many days a word waits in each of the 5 review boxes (right first time with no help moves a word up a box; taught, wrong in a test or skipped moves it back to box 1). max_session_words: the most words in one practice. confidence_words: words already learned that are added to a practice for confidence. reveal_after_test_mistake: false = after a wrong test answer AlfieBot doesn't say the spelling, and the word goes into practice instead.

ai._comment: The AI brain. enabled: false uses only the hand-written replies. local_provider: ollama (a real AI model on this computer, see ollama.com) or mock (a pretend AI, for testing). If Ollama isn't running or the model isn't installed, the pretend AI answers instead and the AI brain panel says why. local_model: the Ollama model, e.g. qwen3:1.7b (best answers in the laptop benchmark), qwen3:0.6b (fastest) or gemma3:1b (install with: ollama pull qwen3:1.7b). AlfieBot never downloads models itself. mode: local_only, cloud_only or automatic. The cloud settings are in the cloud section. timeout_s: how long AlfieBot waits for an AI answer before giving a hand-written reply. max_tokens: the longest AI answer. mock_delay_s: makes the pretend AI take this long, to see the thinking face.

memory._comment: What AlfieBot remembers of a conversation, in memory only (never saved). conversation_turns: how many recent lines it keeps for the AI. conversation_idle_minutes: forgets them after this long without talking. It also forgets everything when it goes to sleep.

cloud._comment: Cloud AI. PARENT SETTINGS. enabled: false by default. child_data_review_complete: only set this to true once an adult has read the cloud provider's terms and child-data rules and is happy for a child's general questions (never personal ones) to be sent; until then only an adult test session (typed text in the developer panel) can use the cloud. provider: mock (a pretend cloud, nothing leaves the computer) or openai. model: the OpenAI model. The API key is never stored here: set it in the environment variable named in api_key_env (e.g. in PowerShell: setx OPENAI_API_KEY "sk-...", then reopen PowerShell). timeout_s, max_retries: per request. price_input_per_million / price_output_per_million: US dollars per million tokens, for the cost estimate (check the provider's current prices). daily_budget_usd: no more cloud requests today once the estimated spend reaches this.

router._comment: slow_local_s: if the local AI's recent answers take longer than this, it is asked for shorter answers (it never sends anything to the cloud instead). unhealthy_after_failures: after this many failures in a row an AI rests for cooldown_s seconds.

privacy._comment: Parent settings. The microphone stays off until a parent turns it on. wake_word_enabled: when true (and the microphone is allowed), the microphone also stays open while AlfieBot is asleep or idle, listening only for "Hey AlfieBot" on this computer; anything else is ignored and nothing is saved. Audio is never saved unless keep_audio_recordings is true.

sounds._comment: Short electronic sound effects (made by the code, no files). bubbly / classic: use them with that personality. wake, listen, celebrate: each effect on or off. volume: 0-1.
